original_test_intent: Verify Link LED OFF/linked state and vendor-defined speed color for every required1G LAN, PDB BMC and dedicated BMC NIC port under known power/cable/link conditions.
original_method: Qualified operator identifies each port from the approved map, records system/cable/link-partner state, photographs the LED with timestamp/label and compares exact state/color to the vendor speed table; OS/BMC link data only corroborates.
manual_activity: Operator physically identifies and photographs every required Link LED under the approved system/link condition.
required_inputs: Approved physical port map for1G LAN, PDB BMC and dedicated BMC NIC
Vendor LED state/color-to-speed definition per port hardware
Expected system power, cable and link-partner state plus negotiated speed
Qualified operator, safe visibility and photo/video capture
Optional secure OS/BMC read-only corroboration and ambiguity policy
safety_requirements: Verify correct port and safe physical access
Do not unplug/replug cables or alter network/BMC configuration solely for observation
Stop on wrong/ambiguous port, damaged connector, unsafe access or unreadable color
No automatic link toggle or power cycle
agent_execution_scope: Organize operator media and optional OS/BMC link/speed data per port
Compare state/color to supplied vendor matrix without visual invention
Do not claim LED visibility, manipulate link/cable/power or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide authoritative port and LED speed/color map
Ensure known power/link conditions and resolve ambiguous colors
Review per-port evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no agent command can see the physical Link LED; operator visual evidence is authoritative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual labeled per-port Link LED observation under approved power/cable/link state; optional read-only negotiated-speed corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OFF/no-link/system-off, color-speed mapping, three required port classes and35/35 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-port state matrix with physical LED media and time-aligned negotiated-link evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity, environmental state, media traceability and non-disruption boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; OS/BMC link status cannot replace color/state observation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: LED color perception depends on lighting/camera and hardware revision; shared or BMC ports may expose link through a different management path.

project_override_considerations: Project must identify each physical port and hardware-revision-specific LED table; no generic Ethernet color convention is assumed.
expected_evidence: Approved labeled port map and vendor LED speed/color definition
Per-port system power, cable/link-partner and negotiated-speed conditions
Labeled timestamped photos/videos of Link LEDs
Expected-versus-observed OFF/link/color matrix and ambiguity notes
Optional OS/BMC link/speed logs, final unchanged state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Link LED state, speed color and required ports are internally consistent. Port identities and vendor color table are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator, port map, color definition and visibility can be supplied; the case is manual rather than inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Expands generic visual inspection into the exact three-port, state and speed-color evidence matrix required by the source.
independent_technical_reasoning: Negotiated speed can corroborate the expected color, but an LED driver, light pipe or board routing fault may leave software link normal while the physical indication is wrong. Conversely an OFF LED is valid only when the exact port, system power and link-partner/cable state are known. Physical media and electronic status must be time-aligned but remain separate evidence types.
